name: Lieutenant Nevell
summary: Outside Ironforge in Dun Morogh, Lieutenant Nevell watches for the Scourge. The Argent Dawn officer coordinates local defenders and warns arriving adventurers of undead threats near the dwarven kingdom.

sections.title: A Watch in the Snow
sections.body: Lieutenant Nevell watches Ironforge's snowy approaches for the Scourge. Though the Argent Dawn is best known for holding the line in Lordaeron's shattered Plaguelands, its watch reaches farther south. From outside Ironforge, Nevell directs recruits and capable adventurers toward the front when Scourge activity stirs in Dun Morogh's mountain passes. The dwarven city's borders remain under watch.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Nevell serves the Argent Dawn near Ironforge in Dun Morogh. He rallies local defenders and investigates signs of the Scourge near the dwarven realm.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn outside Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn watches for undead incursions across the continent, though its main presence is in Lordaeron. Officers such as Nevell monitor Dun Morogh and coordinate defenses against Scourge threats.

faq.q: What does Lieutenant Nevell ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Nevell sends capable adventurers beyond Ironforge's gates to scout and fight nearby Scourge forces before the undead can establish a foothold in the mountain passes.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you have the Argent Dawn watching over your mountain home against necromancy on Dun Morogh's cold slopes.
As an Alliance champion entering Ironforge, you see that the war against the Scourge reaches beyond the north.
